I've fixed the `slugify` function in `<scratch>/exp1/results/.work/dcf0bd453f/repo/src/slugify.py`. 

The issue was that consecutive non-alphanumeric characters (like multiple spaces or punctuation marks) were being replaced individually with hyphens, resulting in multiple consecutive hyphens. The fix:

1. Changed the regex from `r"[^a-z0-9]"` to `r"[^a-z0-9]+"` to match sequences of consecutive special characters and replace them with a single hyphen
2. Added `.strip("-")` to remove any leading or trailing hyphens

All 5 tests now pass.
